# NXTPoint Logistics

NXTPoint Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. NXTPoint is a logistics company that offers 3PL services in supply chain management, warehousing, distribution, fulfillment services, FF&E logistics, and transportation management. NXTPoint Logistics employs 264 people (+10.9% YoY, +26 people), founded in 1919. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, United States.

## About

Built on Trust. Ready for What's Next. NXTPoint Logistics is a full-service supply chain partner that simplifies complex logistics challenges with customized, end-to-end solutions. We combine the scale and reach of a global provider with the flexibility of a trusted partner, delivering seamless experiences through technology, expertise and a people-driven, customer-focused approach.

With broad 3PL capabilities, industry-leading logistics technology and deep expertise across industries, NXTPoint helps clients reach new levels of efficiency, service, and profitability.

We provide greater optimization across your supply chain through:
☑ 35+ owned facilities
☑ 4+ million sq. ft. of warehouse space
☑ Extensive partner network
☑ Broad capabilities of a large 3PL
☑ Flexible, responsive approach of a niche provider

Whether you need to scale up or streamline your supply chain operations, NXTPoint has the reach and resources to take your business where it needs to go.

# NXTPoint Final Mile

NXTPoint Final Mile is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. NXTPoint Logistics provides businesses flexible and scalable final mile delivery services of heavy, oversized and bulky goods. NXTPoint Final Mile employs 3 people, founded in 2022. Headquartered in Coppell, Texas, United States, with an office in Jacksonville.
